sections.ingredients:
Conessi (Holarrhena antidysentrica)

fullContent:
Kutajathwagadi Leham 
 Reference: Ashtanga Hridayam 
 Introduction 
 Kutajathwagadi Leham is an herbal formulation in a jam/paste form and it is also called Kutajavaleha. It aids in the treatment of diarrhea, dysentery, IBS. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Conessi (Holarrhena antidysentrica) 
 False black pepper (Embelica ribes) 
 Sweet flag (Acorus calamus) 
 Indian leadwort (Plumbago rossea) 
 Dry ginger (Zingiber officinale) 
 Black pepper (Piper nigrum) 
 Long pepper (Piper longum) 
 Wood apple (Aegle marmelos) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Prepare a concoction of Conessi and add the remaining ingredients in it and heat the mixture till you attain a semisolid consistency. Remove it from flame and let it cool down. When t is cool to the touch add honey to it. 
 Dosage 
 5 to 10 grams two times a day after meals or as advised by the doctor. 
 Indications 
 
 Dysentery 
 Diarrhea 
 Enhances digestion 
 IBS 
 Sprue 
 Bleeding piles 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 It should be avoided in constipation and piles and IBS with constipation. 
 Higher dosage might case constipation. 
 It should be stored away from heat and moisture. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
